commonPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production skeuomorphic desktop UI icon, 1024x1024 square PNG with TRUE RGBA TRANSPARENCY.
Design a premium original physical-object icon for a quiet research library app. Carefully crafted early Smartisan/macOS-style miniature product rendering: refined, believable, tactile, restrained. The icon must be an irregular free-standing silhouette, NOT an app tile or a symbol engraved in a rounded square.
Camera: near frontal orthographic view, elevated just 12 degrees, slight view of the right-hand thickness. Stable upright composition. Object occupies approximately 80% of the square image with even transparent margins; fully visible, nothing cropped.
Lighting: one large softbox at upper left, 10 o'clock, 45 degree elevation. Broad soft highlights on upper-left-facing edges, subtly darker lower-right faces, realistic very short soft contact shadow integrated as PARTIAL ALPHA. Fine ambient occlusion only at physical seams, never a thick black outline.
Materials: saturated but sophisticated physical material colors, believable microtexture, warm neutral studio white balance, crisp silhouette and bold proportions readable when reduced to 40 pixels. No excessive distressed patina, grime, plastic toy look, inflated clay, exaggerated bevels, bloom or neon.
Background: genuinely transparent pixels, NOT white, NOT grey, NOT a checkerboard drawn into the image, no surface/floor/horizon, no backdrop, no framing badge, no label, no letters or numbers, no watermark.

library.subject: Subject: three slim upright hardcover research books in a compact fan arrangement, their spines and a small amount of cover visible, on their own without a shelf or stand. One oxblood red cloth-bound volume, one deep muted jade-green cloth volume, one warm ivory cloth volume. Real ivory page blocks, subtle vertical weave, delicately rounded spine edges, two very thin blind-stamped spine rules and a small red fabric bookmark. A distinctive simple compact silhouette, all three book bases aligned; no writing.

notes.subject: Subject: one upright pocket research notebook with a warm ochre yellow cloth cover, a dark oxblood fabric spine on the left, a slim silver wire clip at the top, a visible ivory paper block on the right, and a sharpened dark graphite wooden pencil resting diagonally against the notebook. An elegant small blank ivory label pressed onto the cover, NO writing. Readable notebook and pencil silhouette, carefully modelled binding thickness.

search.subject: Subject: one professional handheld magnifying glass, upright on a diagonal with the round lens in the upper left and the handle running toward the lower right. A slim polished satin nickel-silver metal rim, a dark oxblood turned wooden handle with a fine metal ferrule, optically clear glass with a very faint blue-grey tint and a soft upper-left studio reflection. The glass lens must be partially transparent so a UI background remains visible through it; show no reflected scenery. Elegant proportions, simple instantly recognizable silhouette.

tags.subject: Subject: two small physical index tags partially overlapping, one warm terracotta red leather tag in front and one natural ivory paper tag slightly behind, tilted by just 8 degrees in opposite directions. Both have classic clipped top corners and a small precision brass eyelet at the top, joined by a short cream cotton loop. The red tag has a small blind-embossed horizontal rule but NO lettering. Tactile leather grain, thin paper edge, perfectly legible tag silhouette.

logo.prompt: Edit the supplied NeuInk emblem. Change ONLY its color and material palette to suit a warm, restrained skeuomorphic research-library desktop UI. Keep the existing exact symmetric book-pages-plus-fountain-pen-nib silhouette, proportions, front view, negative spaces, size and framing. Replace all blue enamel with matte dark walnut-brown / warm bronze faces (roughly #69503C), and replace the cold silver outlines with fine muted brushed-brass highlights (roughly #B89A63, pale warm edges #D8C39A). The dominant face must remain medium-dark enough to read clearly on ivory paper. Very thin warm ivory edge light from upper left; flat faces and hairline bevels only. Refined satin material, no glossy bubble effect, no thick gold border, no glitter, no neon, no new extrusion. Genuine transparent RGBA alpha background including internal cutouts, no checkerboard painted into image, no colored background or backing tile, no lettering, no added shapes. Preserve the logo faithfully; output ONE complete production PNG icon.

logoBlueV1.prompt: Edit the supplied local NeuInk logo into ONE production-ready transparent PNG asset for the top-left of a desktop application's restrained skeuomorphic theme. This source image is the authoritative logo, not loose inspiration. Preserve its exact recognizable symmetric silhouette, all book-page shapes, the central fountain pen nib and circular hole, proportions and negative spaces. Preserve the existing rich ink-blue brand color. Render the blue regions as very shallow satin blue enamel, with hairline cool metal edges and a restrained upper-left white edge highlight; flat fronts, almost no extrusion. Think a finely manufactured small emblem, crisp and readable at 30px. Strict front orthographic view, no perspective tilt, no surrounding tile, no backing plaque, no added square or rounded background, no text or letter N, no decorative extra elements, no bulbous or pillow bevels, no heavy drop shadow. Genuine RGBA transparent alpha background including internal negative spaces, no checkerboard painted into the image, no solid background. Center the mark and fill approximately 90% of square canvas width, keeping entire silhouette and a small transparent margin. Output one icon, not a sheet of variants.

assistant.prompt: Generate ONE transparent PNG skeuomorphic AI conversation icon for the NeuInk desktop research library. The attached books are STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for muted oxblood leather, ivory paper, restrained realistic light and handcrafted materials; do not include books in the output. Subject: two compact overlapping physical speech-message cards, rectangular with crisp tiny corner radii and a short angular speech tail. One warm ivory heavy-paper message card in front, a muted oxblood red fine-leather message card slightly offset behind. Three tiny inset antique-brass dots on the ivory card clearly signify conversation. Both faces are flat, only thin believable material thickness, refined paper edge and subtle leather grain. Almost frontal orthographic view, very slight right-side depth, soft upper-left light, only a small contact shadow where the cards overlap. A legible compact silhouette at 30px, matching the supplied physical-object icon. No bubble-like swelling, no rounded capsule shape, no large inflated bevel, no outer app tile, no backing plaque, no robot, no microphone, no extra objects, no text, no letters, no blue glow. Center complete icon at about 85% of a square canvas. Genuine RGBA transparent background with transparent margins and partially transparent shadow, no floor, no solid background, no painted checkerboard. One icon, not an icon sheet.
